description: This file declares the Buffer class extending Uint8Array with various methods for handling binary data, including constructors, static methods, and instance methods, typical of a Node.js Buffer module. It appears to define the interface for the Buffer class used in Node.js or similar environments.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class representing a binary data buffer with methods for reading, writing, copying, and manipulating data, extending Uint8Array.

methods.name: write(string: string, offset?: number, length?: number, encoding?: string): number; write
methods.description: Writes a string to the buffer with optional offset, length, and encoding.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts buffer data to a string with optional encoding, start, and end positions.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Returns a JSON representation of the Buffer.

methods.name: equals(otherBuffer: Buffer): boolean; equals
methods.description: Checks if this buffer is equal to another buffer.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this buffer with another buffer.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from this buffer to a target buffer.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a new Buffer that references a subset of this buffer's data.

methods.name: writeUIntLE/BE, writeIntLE/BE
methods.description: Writes unsigned/signed integers to the buffer with little/big endian encoding.

methods.name: readUIntLE/BE, readIntLE/BE
methods.description: Reads unsigned/signed integers from the buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: readUInt8, readUInt16LE/BE, readUInt32LE/BE, readInt8, etc.
methods.description: Methods for reading integers of various sizes and endianness.

methods.name: writeUInt8/16/32, writeInt8/16/32, writeFloatLE/BE, writeDoubleLE/BE
methods.description: Methods for writing various types of numeric data into buffer.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a specified value.

methods.name: indexOf, lastIndexOf, includes
methods.description: Methods for searching within the buffer.

ctags.name: write
ctags.pattern: /^    write(string: string, offset?: number, length?: number, encoding?: string): number;$/
